verses.1: We too must endure this suffering. With so many sins weighing upon us, we must bear all of them and our most serious sins. By patience, we will continue to face this battle that lies before us.
verses.2: They carried Jesus, the leader and culmination of faith, who, instead of joy for those who followed him, chose to endure the shame of being crucified. They placed him on the right side of the throne of God.
verses.3: For you have understood how such deception is used by the wicked against themselves, so that they may not be led astray by their own thoughts.
verses.4: Not until they were replaced by blood did they stand against sin.
verses.5: And you are chosen for this position of responsibility, as if you were your father’s children. My children, do not neglect the lessons taught by your father; do not be deceived by him.
verses.6: For he loves him deeply; the Lord teaches him well, and he accepts him as his son.
verses.7: You must be obedient in your childhood. For as children, God offers you something to enjoy. After all, which child doesn’t receive something from their father when they are young?
verses.8: But if there are no children left, then all those who were supposed to be participants have disappeared. In that case, they are not children anymore.
verses.9: Then, we would make our fleshly fathers our teachers and students. Wouldn’t it be better for us to submit to the control of our fathers’ souls and live accordingly?
verses.10: Those, after all, were those who were trained for a few days, while the other one was prepared to inherit his holiness.
verses.11: But all childhood experiences, at first, seem not to bring joy, but rather sorrow. Later on, however, they bring some kind of peace and harmony to those who have been taught through them.
verses.12: Therefore, you corrected the bent arms and the distorted knees.
verses.13: And make straight tracks for your horses, so that the wheels won’t get damaged. This will also help to prevent any accidents.
verses.14: You seek peace at all costs, as well as sanctity. For no one else sees the Lord at all.
verses.15: Not one person should be left behind by the grace of God; not one person should be left without help. Many will be troubled and distressed because of this.
verses.16: May she not be a prostitute or a whore, like Esau. Instead of giving her children to others, she should keep them for herself.
verses.17: For it is true that even later on, he wanted to inherit the blessing. He didn’t find a place for repentance, and so he demanded it after paying the required offering.
verses.18: For you were not exposed to a burning fire, nor to flames, nor to smoke, nor to heat, nor to any other dangers.
verses.19: And the lyre also has sounds and tones. Those who hear these sounds say that they should not be added to their speech.
verses.20: For he did not bring the one who was sent to be executed. Even if it were a monster from the mountains, it would still be punished accordingly.
verses.21: And it was so terrifying to imagine that, said Moses. “I am also afraid and distressed.”
verses.22: But you were sent up to Mount Sinai and to the city of God’s living being, Jerusalem in heaven. And you were also sent as messengers, to bring glory to God.
verses.23: And by the assembly of those who were first recorded in heaven, and by the judge of all things, and by the spirits of justice who were completed.
verses.24: And a new covenant was made through Jesus; and he spoke with bloodshed, according to the teachings of Abel.
verses.25: Don’t give up on those who speak out. For if those people don’t leave this earth and stop supporting those who make money, then it will be even worse for us who are being driven away from heaven.
verses.26: The voice that then shook the earth, now is called upon to speak: “Even now, I will not only shake the earth, but also the heavens.”
verses.27: And Eti clearly indicates those who are in a position of power as being entitled to what they don’t deserve. In other words, they are supposed to keep for themselves what doesn’t belong to them.
verses.28: Therefore, by taking the throne in an honest manner, we can enjoy it. This is why we are able to worship God with joy and devotion.
verses.29: For indeed, our God has consumed our fire.
